выбраться.gloss: to get out / make it here

meanings.en: to get out / make it here
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'браться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get out / make it here'.

examples.text: Я рада, что вам удалось выбраться.
examples.trans: I am glad that you managed to make it out here.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и выбраться вовремя.
